data.name: Avni
data.gender_notes: Avni is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit avani, 'earth, the earth goddess'. Its root is Sanskrit avani (अवनि). A classical Sanskrit name for the earth. Avni is a Sanskrit name meaning “Earth; the earth goddess”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Avni expresses “Earth; the earth goddess”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit avani, 'earth, the earth goddess'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avni total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
